review_description: Sun Group Energy, were informative, efficient and supportive.  Everything went so smoothly with hardly any disruptions to the running of our home. The whole operation was up and running within days, with a supportive team on hand to organise the grid connection, how to read the phone app and a check list of the best times during the day of what electrical good to use to take advantage of the panels.    It was so much easier than we expected. Would highly recommend Sun Group Energy

My experience with understanding solar options and the merits of different systems was first rate, with Tony sitting down demonstrating and analysing the options at my house in Cammeray.  This was supported by Joan in the back office, providing all supporting materials and following up on any questions.Installation by Simon’s team demonstrated strong professionalism and courtesy.At every step of the process, things were clearly explained to me with follow up to ensure that I understood everything.Overall, a first rate seamless process.

Christian who was the representative of SunGroup was excellent and followed the installation up by being on the job to make sure everything was done as quotedThe installer was excellent and to date everything foretold has happenedThe staff at the Vic office were excellent and followed up the installation of the solarAt this stage more than happy with the end resultThank youBarbara

Quick and efficient! I found the whole process with Aladin Radwan from Sungroup Energy so easy to understand he explained the math and how my savings would work and blew me away with his knowledge but also how friendly he was   Everything made sense and the process was quick with no problems what so ever! i don't know why i hadn't done this years ago the installation happened 3 days later and the unit produces double my daily usage even in winter I'm very happy and would recommend this to everyone

I found the whole process with Aladin Radwan from Sungroup Energy so easy to understand and comforting to know that I'll get the best system for my house. Everything seemed to make sense and  the process was quick with no problems what so ever! When I look to increase the capacity of my system I'll give them another call for sure.

I just had a 6.64 kW solar system installed from Sun Group Sydney. The service was great and the installation was done to a high standard and in a timely manner. The team supported me throughout the installation process and also answered any questions I had (which were many!). I would recommend them for other peoples installations.John W.

John Bartzis was absolutley fantastic nothing was too much trouble he was very helpful and plus the fact he is a Carlton supporter What more can I say would have no hesitation in recommending your company to anyone and as for Andy and his installation team they were unreal when they left you wouldnt even know that they had been here everything was cleaned  up and a totally professional team many thanks to all of of you wish you all the very best for Christmas and the New YearRegards Graeme

We found John Bartzis to be pleasant, punctual and patient. He explained the process of solar installation in terms that we (non-technically-minded oldies!) could understand and was happy to answer all our questions, both at the time of his visit and afterwards. The actual installation of the panels was straightforward and hassle-free and we can now look forward to lower electricity bills.

The team installed the system in a timely manner and were polite. Leigh kept my up to date with the whole process. Nothing was too much trouble. She was kind and friendly. They helped me with the grid connection too.
